description: This file contains functions for symbolic type inference, unification, and type substitution within the PyTorch FX framework, specifically related to the experimental unify_refinements module.

methods.name: infer_symbolic_types_single_pass
methods.description: Performs a single pass of symbolic type inference on a traced graph.

methods.name: infer_symbolic_types
methods.description: Performs two passes of symbolic type inference to handle complex cases like broadcasting.

methods.name: convert_eq
methods.description: Converts a list of equality constraints into a format suitable for unification.

methods.name: unify_eq
methods.description: Applies unification to a set of equality constraints.

methods.name: substitute_solution_one_type
methods.description: Applies the most general unifier to a single type, handling Var, TensorType, list, and tuple types.

methods.name: substitute_all_types
methods.description: Applies unification results to all types in a graph until reaching a fixed point.

methods.name: check_for_type_equality
methods.description: Checks if two graphs have the same types for corresponding nodes.
